# `time_trunc`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
time_trunc(unit, time)
```

Returns `time` truncated to the `unit`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT time_trunc('HOUR', TIME'09:32:05.359');
```

Result:

```text
09:00:00
```

```sql
SELECT time_trunc('MILLISECOND', TIME'09:32:05.123456');
```

Result:

```text
09:32:05.123
```
